<div class="eyebrow">About</div>

# Sisyphe is a small company with a long run-up.

## What Sisyphe does

Sisyphe builds AI for art, music and creative tools: agents that perceive a live environment and work inside it, whether that is a DAW, a stage, a gallery or an archive. The bet is simple: a model that can see the whole environment and notice what changed is more useful than a chatbot beside it with a list of commands. Sisyphe began in 2023 as a consulting practice: real-time conversational voice for Persona, music source separation advisory for Parts Order, fractional CTO for Tamada's AI-augmented art curation. Sideman, in 2026, is its first product. The course teaches it. Consulting pays for it and keeps us honest about what works outside our own studio.

Sisyphe is independent of any employer. Client work never touches what the founder does at a day job, and the day job is not for hire here.

## Who runs it

::: {.founder}
<img src="assets/sylvain.jpg" alt="Sylvain Le Groux">

<div>
**Sylvain Le Groux** founded Sisyphe after two decades between research and industry: interactive music systems and emotion research in labs in Barcelona and at Stanford, then speech and language models shipped to millions of users at Voicea and Cisco. Ph.D. in computer and cognitive science, trained as a musician, based in Santa Monica. The full story, papers and awards are on [his personal site](https://ccrma.stanford.edu/~slegroux).
</div>
:::



## Two decades, one idea {#background}

::: {.lede .muted}
Before Sisyphe there were twenty years of systems that perceive what is happening and answer with an action: a room that composed from how people moved through it, a string quartet played by brain signals, an arena where robots drove the score, and speech models heard by millions. This is the founder's background, not the company's portfolio; what Sisyphe itself has built is on [Projects](projects.html).
:::

### Speech at scale
<div class="eyebrow meta">Ava · Voicea · Cisco</div>
<div class="chips"><span class="chip perceive">perceive</span><span class="chip reason">reason</span></div>
Multilingual speech recognition, speaker diarization, synthesis and language modelling shipped to millions of Webex users, and a US patent on privacy-preserving speech recognition with federated learning. The perception layer at scale. <a href="https://slegroux.github.io/nimrod">Nimrod</a>, a personal open-source toolkit for speech, audio and language modelling, came out of this period.

::: {.tl}
<div class="year">2010</div>
<div>
### The Robot Arena
<div class="eyebrow meta">Sónar, Barcelona · SPECS</div>
<div class="chips"><span class="chip perceive">perceive</span><span class="chip reason">reason</span></div>
The behaviour of robots in an arena modulates a musical composition generated live by SiMS, the Situated Interactive Music Server. Its biomimetic architecture uses algorithmic composition, sound synthesis and expression rules validated in psychoacoustics and emotion experiments.
</div>
{{< video https://www.youtube.com/embed/HDmjGJ9sqeI title="The Robot Arena" >}}
:::

::: {.tl}
<div class="year">2009</div>
<div>
### The Brain Orchestra
<div class="eyebrow meta">Brain-computer interface · with SPECS, Jonatas Manzolli and g.tec</div>
<div class="chips"><span class="chip perceive">perceive</span><span class="chip act">act</span></div>
Four performers control the expressivity of a virtual string quartet with their brain signals alone. Sylvain designed and built the interactive music system on top of the BCI, produced the music with Decco, and played live guitar and electronics.
</div>
<a class="vidlink" href="https://vimeo.com/35514990"><img src="assets/work/brain-orchestra.jpg" alt="The Brain Orchestra on stage: performers wearing EEG caps in front of a screen"><span>▶ Watch on Vimeo</span></a>
:::

::: {.tl}
<div class="year">2007–2009</div>
<div>
### The eXperience Induction Machine
<div class="eyebrow meta">Mixed reality space · SPECS, Barcelona</div>
<div class="chips"><span class="chip perceive">perceive</span><span class="chip reason">reason</span><span class="chip act">act</span></div>
A real-world composition and performance system inside a large intelligent multimodal space. The music is produced in real time by the interaction between the system and its human and non-human environment. The music system inside XIM became the subject of the Ph.D.: a room as an instrument.
</div>
{{< video https://www.youtube.com/embed/XAlptm4aHNA title="XIM" >}}
:::

::: {.tl}
<div class="year">2007</div>
<div>
### Re(per)curso
<div class="eyebrow meta">Multimedia performance · SPECS and Jonatas Manzolli</div>
<div class="chips"><span class="chip perceive">perceive</span><span class="chip act">act</span></div>
Narrative, music and dance fused with real-time synthetic composition, video art and 3D graphics. Sylvain designed the interactive music system, integrated it with the lab's neural network simulator, built the software for an interactive percussion carpet, produced the music and played live electronics.
</div>
{{< video https://www.youtube.com/embed/qln4f1kUpZU title="Re(per)curso" >}}
:::
